subject: model prediction using a raster stack: accounting for resolution

messages.author: c30c9e29d10d3cd7
messages.subject: model prediction using a raster stack: accounting for resolution
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to account for area in my model prediction.

In chapter 8, pg 442 the area of the pixel size is accounted for with the following code:

cruz.s<-cruz
cruz.s$elevation<- (cruz$elevation80.348-202)/125
cruz.s$chaparral<-(cruz$chaparral-0.270)/0.234
cruz.s$area<-(300*300)/1000
 EN<-predict(nb.C2E.C, type="lambda", newdata=cruz.s)
 
However, I am not sure how to similarly incorporate area into my model.
Any advice would be greatly appreciated.

Thanks

I

#######################################################################################

WWL<-gdistsamp(lambdaformula = ~riv + lake + prec + temp +offset(log(area)), phiformula = ~1,
    pformula = ~OBS, data = umf, keyfun = "exp", output = "abund",
    unitsOut = "ha", mixture = "NB")

layers <- list.files(pattern="tif$", full.names=FALSE)
layers

#stackkazc10a_Clip=river
#stackkazc12a_Clip=lake
#stackkazc2a_clipNDVI=
#stackkazc4a_Clip=temp
#stackkazc6a_Clip=prec
#stackkazc8a_Clip=elevation

#create four raster objects (coordinate system already specified).
riv <- raster("stackkazc10a_Clip.tif")
lake<- raster("stackkazc12a_Clip.tif")
prec<- raster("stackkazc6a_Clip.tif")
temp<- raster("stackkazc4a_Clip.tif")

sc.s # data set for the scaled variables
attributes (sc.s)

#$`scaled:center`
#       ndvi        temp        prec         ele         riv         set        lake  Activefire    firefreq    Firecomb
#107.7638431  58.2120523 205.3780557 253.4246731   0.1981767   0.2733345   0.4512685   0.1569073   0.2029562   0.3013076

#$`scaled:scale`
#       ndvi        temp        prec         ele         riv         set        lake  Activefire    firefreq    Firecomb
# 24.1685758  19.7543778  53.1457608 146.3752595   0.2406652   0.2432223   0.4376988   0.5063272   0.5228263   0.6559030

#Since I standardized the covariates during the modelling process, I need to transform the country-wide data using the same values


riv.s <- (riv-0.1981767)/0.2406652
lake.s <- (lake-0.4512685)/0.4376988
prec.s <- (prec-205.3780557)/53.1457608
temp.s <- (temp-58.2120523)/19.7543778

habitat <- stack(riv.s, lake.s, prec.s, temp.s)
names(habitat) <- c("riv", "lake", "prec", "temp")

res(habitat)
extent(habitat)
projection(habitat)
habitat
